name: fn_add_numbers
description: Use ONLY when the user asks to add, sum, plus, total, increase by, or combine two numbers.

name: fn_subtract_numbers
description: Use ONLY when the user asks to subtract, minus, difference, deduct, take away, or remove one number from another

name: fn_multiply_numbers
description: Use ONLY when the user asks to multiply, times, product, or repeated multiplication.

name: fn_divide
description: Use ONLY when the user asks to divide, quotient, split equally, over, or per
